author: Original assets generated for Damián Curti / Caelum Argenteum

stove.prompt: Create one original inventory/world fallback sprite for Caelum Argenteum, a dark-fantasy RPG inspired by 1889 Argentina. One compact nineteenth-century coal cooking stove, approximately 70 cm wide, 65 cm deep, 80 cm high at the hotplate, soot-dark cast iron on four short feet, two concentric round hotplates on top, small ash/firebox doors with worn brass handles, restrained moulded trim, short rear flue extending upward. It is the stovetop half of a Victorian cooking range; no large oven door. Full object in front three-quarter view, centered, entirely visible. Painted pixel-oriented game art, broad deliberate brush clusters, warm umber shadows, matte charcoal iron, restrained ochre highlights, soft consistent upper-left light. Recognizable silhouette at 128 pixels. No glossy 3D render, no photography, no labels or text, no people, no scenery, no floor or cast shadow. Transparent background with a clean alpha cutout and generous separation from canvas edges. Preserve period practical construction.
